facts.text: Elkton was platted on January 25, 1887, by W.E., marking the town's formal layout before it grew into a small community.
Elkton was officially incorporated on January 2, 1906, establishing its municipal government and paving the way for local services.
On January 30, 1906, residents elected a city council president, three councilmen, a recorder, a treasurer, two justices of the peace, two constables, and an assessor.
A sidewalk was built on Main Street in 1908, electricity arrived in the late 1920s, and a water system was installed in 1946.
In 1965, Elkton upgraded its streets by adding curbs, gutters, and new roadways, improving traffic flow and drainage.
Elkton sits in central Mower County, 15 miles east of the county seat, and is drained by Schwerin Creek, which feeds Rose Creek, a Cedar River tributary.
